cc:Work.dc:title: Regional temporal errors and a separately trained eastern transfer test.
cc:Work.dc:description: Experiment 04 retrospective benchmark: train through 2022, evaluate 2023–2025. Final 14-year model is not evaluated here.

g.text: Lower error is better · all comparisons within each panel use identical labels and date windows
The eastern transfer fit never uses eastern VIIRS labels. Its source mask and calibration are learned in the training area.
NASA FIRMS-derived local archive; 0.25° grid. VIIRS is an observation reference, not ground-truth fire.
